item.title: Headline Above the Coach

turns.text: Make a 4:5 social image of a smiling female fitness coach in a bright studio. Put “Start where you are” at the top, not over her face. Keep it upbeat, no other text.

item.tests: Checks that the finished composition reserves top space for the headline and keeps the face unobscured.

answer_sheet.Headline and other wording: Use exactly “Start where you are” and no other text.
answer_sheet.Headline placement: At the top of the image, above the coach's face, without overlapping it.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: 4:5 portrait social image; no particular platform.
answer_sheet.Person and setting: An invented smiling female fitness coach in a bright studio; no reference photo.

must_haves: The headline reads exactly “Start where you are” and sits in the top portion of the image.
No headline letters overlap the coach's face; her full face remains visible.
A smiling female fitness coach is clearly depicted in a bright studio.
The headline is readable, fully inside the canvas, and accompanied by no other text.

turns.text: Make a 4:5 social image of a smiling female fitness coach in a bright studio. Put “Start where you are” at the top, not over her face. Keep it upbeat, no other text. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Nothing has run or used any credits.

The lowest listed free-plan image price is **5 credits for one image at 640px** using Flux 2 Klein. There’s one catch: the text-to-image tool supports square, portrait 9:16, or landscape—not 4:5 directly.

| Option | Listed cost | Result |
|---|---:|---|
| **Cheapest** | **5 credits** | Generate a 640px square with a crop-safe layout; you crop it to 4:5 in your social app or editor. |
| 4:5 through Magic Hour | **10 credits total** | Generate the image, then use a second image-editing step to request 4:5. |

These are the listed base costs; I can’t verify your balance or an account-specific quote with the tools available here.

**My recommendation:** the 5-credit option, with the smiling female fitness coach in a bright studio, an upbeat look, and **“Start where you are”** in clear space above her face. No other text. I’d keep everything important inside a central 4:5 crop area.

640px is the smallest listed free-plan size; going smaller doesn’t offer a listed saving. “Shorter” doesn’t apply to a still image.

Would you like to authorize the **5-credit, crop-it-yourself option**, or the **10-credit two-step option**?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that — the 5-credit option.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the 5-credit generation because your account has **insufficient credits**. Nothing was created, and no credits were spent.

I won’t retry or run a paid alternative. The cheapest listed option is still 5 credits; a smaller image wouldn’t lower that price.

args.name: Start Where You Are — Fitness Coach

style.prompt: Create an upbeat photorealistic social media fitness image. Square composition deliberately designed for a later CENTRAL 4:5 crop: keep all important content inside the central 80% of image width, leaving expendable space on the left and right. A smiling adult female fitness coach in tasteful colorful athletic workout clothing in a bright, airy modern fitness studio, natural sunlight, welcoming encouraging expression, energetic optimistic atmosphere, clean polished professional photography. Medium portrait with her face in the middle portion of the frame and her body below. At the TOP, in generous clear uncluttered space ABOVE her head, render exactly this headline in large bold highly legible dark sans-serif typography: “Start where you are”. Keep the entire headline within the central 75% width, use two centered lines if needed. Text must not overlap her face or head. No other text whatsoever, no logos, no watermarks, no labels on clothing or equipment. Maintain generous top and side margins for cropping. Cheerful warm color palette, natural anatomy, realistic skin texture.
